notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Patch notes for this period:

•	How to play Tab update

•	Remade some of the Villain caught stuff, using the character move component and disable 
movement when player is caught.

•	removed some stuff that didn't work as it should, or primary didn't work at all on AI and could also 
be a reason to hang ups.

•	Started to implement some of the player controller logic to the main menu controller

•	Controller update

•	UI Update for Tricks and pickups

•	Tricks combo added

•	Optimized map

Thank you all for still being with us! Feel free to chat with us on the forms.

Remember this is a game built by the community so if there's anything you find or want to see, and we can make it happen we got you!

notes.title: DreamHack fans request update!
notes.notes:
3D Dojo Studios attended the October DreamHack in ATL GA, where we showcased our upcoming PC game called the "DA PAPER BOY" and we was amazed at how many of the folks there became fans of our game. In the mist of everyone enjoying the game so many of y'all made requests of things you would like to see in the game, and as I stated many times this is a community game made by the community. By that being said we have worked very hard and achieved everything that was requested at DreamHack!  

In this video we address everything that was asked for including adding a controller function and more! 

[b]-Patch Notes-[/b]
-You can now shoot the followers with a cost of points
-Achievements enabled
-Controller enabled
-Steam Leaderboard enabled
-Update accuracy on paper, higher velocity and lower gravity 
-Update demo assets
-Update dizzy assets 
-Make skater and bob stunnable with a cost of 2000
-Achievements works to get bike unlocked 
-Loose dog is also stunnable with a loss of 2000 points 
-Cursor size fixed
-Update you can now save game menu

notes.title: Hurricane Helene Impact from 3D Dojo Studios
notes.notes:
If you've heard the story of 3D Dojo Studios, then you've heard us lift up our home city Asheville, NC and Western North Carolina as a whole. It's not just a headquarters, this is our home. The place and the people that we love. Over the last few days, our home has been experiencing apocalyptic levels of devastation. We can't even drive to our office downtown if we wanted to, because trees are in streets, water levels are still high, and there are thousands of people who still cannot leave their homes. Buncombe County has never seen this kind of devastation. 

I've been inspired by my neighbors. We've pull out chainsaws and cut down trees that were trapping our community in place. We've helped each other access food, water, and gas. We created systems to ensure our elder neighbors who couldn't leave their houses had resources. I personally, traversed my neighborhood well to ensure our community didn't lose our running water. We woke up one morning in darkness, without connectivity, and knew immediately that the only way through was together without anyone having to tell us that. I know our community is gonna make it out of this stronger, but as a business, I'm not sure I can say the same... 

As with most indie game studios, 3D Dojo Studios is a project that was created through the creativity and sweat of it's founder Leroy Jones and a very small team who works on this in their spare time. Everything we do is bootstrapped. We've created mentoring courses, that have helped up sustain enough to continue working on our game. All those classes have had to stop. All development on our debut game DA PAPER BOY has had to stop. I don't know how long it's gonna be before we have the access and resources needed to resume. It's all been just us. And in the last few days, I've felt the deep impact that being alone means that our studio may not come back from this. After devastation like this, communities begin getting all kinds of resources funneled in to help rebuild. However, it's a reality that game studios are never considered to qualify for support in that effort.

My family was lucky enough to have the ability to evacuate after days without power, connectivity, and running out of food. Since Atlanta was spared from the destruction Hurricane Helene brought to WNC, we decided to drive down to Atlanta. Our family is safe.

Once we got here, one of the first people who reached out to see if we were okay was a staffer at DreamHack. She personally offered assistance in any way we could need it. Because of that support, my team and I will still be at DreamHack Atlanta this weekend.

We're Asheville's first and only Black-owned game studio. Our goal has always been to break barriers that have left Black people to account for only 4% of all game industry talent. Our dream is to grow with the gaming community and create a space whose sustainability doesn't depend a couple of people's ability to work. But for now all we have is us. It doesn't have to be that way. With your support we can thrive. Or we could fall. I'll tell you right now though, we will not fall without a fight.

notes.title: DreamHack Atlanta 2024
notes.notes: 3D Dojo Studios is bringing DA PAPER BOY to DreamHack Atlanta from Oct 4-6. Come meet us and test out our game in the Indie Game Playground. Use our promo code 3DOJOSTUDIOS to get a 15% discount on 1-day and 3-day DreamHack tickets. You'll get a chance to meet our talented team, learn more about our innovative game, and see it in action. Whether you're a gamer, developer, or just curious about the gaming industry, this is an event you won't want to miss!
